record.question: One of the greatest boxers Muhammad Ali, who died recently, was from which country?
record.explanation: Answer A: United States. Muhammad Ali was from the United States. The US Olympic organization's own athlete record identifies the Louisville, Kentucky boxer, his 1960 US Olympic gold medal and his death in June 2016. Reference: https://www.teamusa.com/hall-of-fame/hall-of-fame-members/muhammad-ali. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
